title: Switch to using more APIs which take context.Context values
body:
#### What type of PR is this?

/kind cleanup

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

Following up on #7007:
* Switch a number of our uses of exec.Command() to exec.CommandContext().
* Catch a few spots where we were still calling non-context-accepting versions of functions in the copier package.
* Add Builder.EnsureContainerPathAsContext(), so that it can pass a context from the caller down to copier.MkdirContext().

#### How to verify it

Updated unit tests!

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

None

None
